statement: ∀ {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (Ω : Finset I → Prop) (p : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun q => ExpandingCodes.SharpThreshold.probability q Ω) (ExpandingCodes.SharpThreshold.totalInfluence p Ω) p
proof_route: Induct over a finite coordinate universe s. Differentiate the existing expectationOn_insert identity by the scalar product rule. The new coordinate's expected gradient is the difference between its two conditional expectations. Every other coordinate gradient commutes with inserting the new coordinate. Summing those identities matches the product-rule derivative. Specialize s to univ and f to the event indicator.
